topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I don't know why I decided to poke around the attic. Maybe it was the dust, thick and undisturbed, whispering of secrets. Or perhaps it was the faint outline of a door, barely visible under decades of neglect. The floor creaked under my feet, each step a loud protest. I found a small, hidden key and the lock turned with a reluctant click. The door swung open to reveal a room, small and cold, with walls that seemed to watch me. Shelves lined with jars, their contents unidentifiable in the dim light. I should leave, but my feet refuse to move. What have I uncovered?
